sources: RIDB campsite catalog for facility 247602 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: Drive-in campsites are $25 a night (2026-2028 peak seasons on recreation.gov); 50% off with an America the Beautiful Senior or Access pass.

fees.source: https://www.nps.gov/piro/planyourvisit/camping.htm ('Drive-in campsites are $25 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/247602/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-10-15: Campground Sites $25)

discounts.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/247602 (fee description: 'America The Beautiful Senior Lifetime, Senior Annual, or Access passes are eligible for a 50% discount on camping per night')

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/247602 ('drive-in campsites are rustic and do not have electric, water, or sewer hookups') + https://www.nps.gov/piro/planyourvisit/camping.htm ('Campsites do not have any hookups')

values.note: Well water, shut off with the toilets after October 15. No dump station anywhere in Pictured Rocks; waste water goes in the vault toilets. No cell reception, typically.

facilities.source: https://www.nps.gov/piro/planyourvisit/camping.htm ('The campgrounds have vault toilets and well water'; 'There are no dump stations at Pictured Rocks') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/247602 (amenities: Drinking Water (peak season))

values.note: NPS: drive-in campgrounds are open May 15 through October 15; water and toilets are shut down after October 15.

season.source: https://www.nps.gov/piro/planyourvisit/camping.htm ('Drive-in campgrounds are open from May 15 through October 15'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: All sites by reservation on recreation.gov, no drop-in camping; same-day reservations are accepted. Most sites open 6 months ahead; sites 4, 26 and 35 open two weeks before arrival and sites 8, 15 and 33 four days before. Camping is limited to 14 days per calendar year within the Lakeshore.

booking.source: https://www.nps.gov/piro/planyourvisit/camping.htm ('All campsites require a reservation. There is no drop-in camping', 'Reservations can be made beginning 6 months in advance') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/247602 (notices: 14 days per calendar year; same-day reservations accepted; two-week and four-day release sites)

values.note: 36 sites (35 bookable standard sites in the recreation.gov catalog, plus a hike-in cabin). NPS recommends single vehicles no more than 36 ft and vehicle plus trailer no more than 42 ft because turning room is limited; catalog lengths run 18 to 36 ft, all back-in.

sites.source: https://www.nps.gov/piro/planyourvisit/camping.htm ('Twelvemile Beach Campground's 36 sites'; 'we recommend single vehicles no more than 36 feet and vehicle/trailer combined length no more than 42 feet') + RIDB campsite catalog for facility 247602

summary: Confirmed $25 base, no hookups (water/sewer now false), Senior/Access 50%. Added season May 15-Oct 15, reservation-only with 6-month window and 14-night yearly limit, vault toilets, well water, no dump station, 36 sites, 36-ft single-vehicle recommendation, all back-in. Not stated: showers, flush toilets.
